subject: BrightBank — demo timing across DST transition (US/EU/APAC)

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + quick demo — timing question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the invite — we’re excited to see the platform. One quick note: our team is spread across San Francisco, London and Singapore. This week the US is about to move clocks forward (US DST) but Europe shifts a week later, so some of our folks will either be double-shifted or unavailable during the window you proposed.

Can we look for a slot that keeps the core demo between 16:00–19:00 UTC so it hits late morning in SF, late afternoon in London, and evening in Singapore? Alternatively, if that’s hard, we can split into two shorter sessions (EU+APAC and US).

Also looping Sophie and Amit to confirm local constraints.

—Michael
Michael Turner
Head of Platform Integrations | BrightBank
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sophie Leclerc <sophie.leclerc@brightbank.eu>, Amit Desai <amit.desai@brightbank-apac.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick demo — timing question

Michael — thanks for the heads up and for the timing window. Good call on the two approaches. A couple notes from our side:

- We can run a single 60–75 minute demo and keep Q&A to 15 minutes to stay within the 16:00–19:00 UTC window you suggested. That would be my preference so we present a single narrative end-to-end.
- We can also offer two 45-minute sessions if you want regional deep dives (APAC/EMEA and Americas).

I’ve attached a quick mutual action plan and a proposed-calendar-options.ics with 3 candidate slots that respect the US/EU DST mismatch week. Could you confirm which option looks best for your team? If none work, we’ll propose alternate times.

Proposed slots (all UTC):
1) 16:30–17:45 UTC — single session (best single-session overlap)
2) 17:00–18:15 UTC — single session (slightly late for SF)
3) Split: 15:30–16:15 UTC (APAC/EMEA deep dive) + 00:00–00:45 UTC next day (Americas — alternate)

If you prefer we’ll set up two invites and label them clearly (EMEA/APAC / Americas).

Thanks — I’ve copied Marissa for calendar ops and Karthik for coverage recommendations across timezones.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), proposed-calendar-options.ics (text/calendar)

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + quick demo — timing question

Looping back with availability notes — I checked the three proposed slots and ran them through our region routing and engineered coverage:

- Slot 1 (16:30–17:45 UTC): Good. Jasmine (west coast) + Karthik (EMEA overlap) + I can cover live. Latency demo will need the 10ms hook disabled for the Singapore demo due to our staging region routing, but we can show the same workflow and follow up with a brief recording of the low-latency path for APAC attendees.
- Slot 2 (17:00–18:15 UTC): Acceptable, but puts SF attendees at lunchtime — not ideal for wider internal BrightBank attendance.
- Split option: workable but doubles prep and costs a bit of extra coordination; fine if you want region-specific deep dives.

Recommendation: Go with Slot 1 (16:30–17:45 UTC UTC). I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-demo note explaining the minor APAC limitation and that we’ll share a recorded low-latency segment post-demo.

Marissa Cole
